definition_en: a claylike ore from which aluminum is obtained
core_image: 红褐色土块，嚼一嚼就是铝的故乡
scene: 露天矿场里红土堆成小山，挖掘机轰鸣。Trucks hauled bauxite from the open pit.
sceneCN: 这里 bauxite 指「铝土矿」（第 1 个义项：炼铝的矿石）；句意：卡车把铝土矿运出露天矿坑。

derivatives.zh: 氧化铝——由 bauxite（基础词，指铝土矿）提炼得到，语义指向其化学产物

senses.title: The aluminum ore
senses.definition: the principal ore of aluminum, a mixture of hydrated oxides
senses.definitionCN: 铝的主要矿石，含水氧化物的混合体
senses.example: Almost all aluminum begins as bauxite.
senses.exampleCN: 几乎所有的铝都始于铝土矿。
senses.why: The rock was first described at Les Baux: the place became the metal's cradle.
senses.whyCN: 该岩石最早描述于莱博村：地名成了金属的摇篮。

senses.title: In industry and trade
senses.definitionCN: 作为开采商品的铝土矿
senses.example: Guinea leads the world in bauxite exports.
senses.exampleCN: 几内亚的铝土矿出口居世界之首。
senses.why: Red rock feeds white metal worldwide.
senses.whyCN: 红色的石头喂养着全球的白色金属。

senses.title: Refined into alumina
senses.definition: bauxite processed into alumina before smelting
senses.definitionCN: 熔炼前先加工成氧化铝
senses.example: The plant refines bauxite into white alumina powder.
senses.exampleCN: 该厂把铝土矿精炼成白色氧化铝粉。
senses.why: Two steps separate red dirt from silver metal.
senses.whyCN: 从红土到银白金属需两道工序。

senses.title: In abrasives and cement
senses.definition: bauxite used for abrasives and aluminous cement
senses.definitionCN: 用作磨料与铝水泥的矾土
senses.why: Its hardness serves where metal cannot.
senses.whyCN: 其硬度可用于金属不能之处。

senses.title: Geological deposits
senses.definition: residual deposits formed by weathering in tropical climates
senses.definitionCN: 热带风化形成的残余矿床
senses.example: Ancient tropical soils became today's bauxite belts.
senses.exampleCN: 古热带土壤形成今日的铝土矿带。
senses.why: Rain washes everything away but the aluminum.

senses.title: Named place and town
senses.definition: towns named for the ore, as Bauxite, Arkansas
senses.definitionCN: 以矿得名的城镇，如阿肯色州 Bauxite
senses.example: Bauxite, Arkansas, boomed a century ago.
senses.exampleCN: 阿肯色州铝城百年前一度繁荣。
senses.why: The ore carried its French village name abroad.
senses.whyCN: 矿石把法国小村之名带往海外。

senses.title: In chemistry writing
senses.definition: the mineral name in oxide analyses
senses.definitionCN: 氧化物分析中的矿物名
senses.example: Bauxite is essentially Al₂O₃ with water.
senses.exampleCN: 铝土矿本质上是含水的氧化铝。
senses.why: Science keeps the proper name for the mixture.
senses.whyCN: 科学以专名称呼此混合物。

senses.title: Strategic resource
senses.definition: bauxite as a material of national importance
senses.definitionCN: 被视为国家要害物资的铝土矿
senses.example: Wartime powers seized the bauxite supply.
senses.exampleCN: 战时权力机构接管了铝土矿供应。
senses.why: Aircraft made aluminum a weapon metal.
senses.whyCN: 飞机使铝成为战争金属。

intro.en: Bauxite was named in 1861 after Les Baux, the village in southern France where the ore was first described; the suffix -ite marks the mineral.
intro.cn: bauxite 于 1861 年得名于法国南部村庄莱博（Les Baux），该矿石最初在此被描述；后缀 -ite 为矿物名标志。

items.en: Les Baux, a limestone village of Provence.
items.cn: 莱博，普罗旺斯的石灰岩村落。

items.en: Henri Sainte-Claire Deville's circle coined bauxite for the ore.
items.cn: 德维尔学派于 1861 年为该矿石造词 bauxite。

items.en: English adopted bauxite with the mineral suffix -ite.
items.cn: 英语随即将 bauxite 连同 -ite 后缀收入。

items.en: The Hall–Héroult process of 1886 made the ore priceless.
items.cn: 1886 年霍尔—埃鲁电解法使该矿石身价百倍。

items.en: The word now names mines, towns, and trade routes.
items.cn: 如今该词指矿山、城镇与贸易航线。

note.en: Group one holds the -ite mineral family and look-alikes; group two holds the ore field.
note.cn: 第一组收 -ite 矿物词族与形近词；第二组收「矿石」义场。

entries.definition: the Provençal village of Les Baux.
a salt of boron; unrelated to bauxite.
not standard; the ore is bauxite.

entries.definitionCN: 由铝土矿精炼的氧化铝。

entries.definition: an iron ore with the same -ite suffix.

normalIntro.en: bauxite is Baux plus -ite: the mineral of Les Baux.
normalIntro.cn: bauxite 即 Baux 加 -ite：莱博村的矿物。

abstract.en: See red earth stacked like rusted hills.
Bauxite is a French village packed into ore trucks.
abstract.cn: bauxite 是被装进矿车的法国村庄。

abstract.en: Rain, in the tropics, mines aluminum for free.
abstract.cn: 热带的雨在免费开采铝。

examples.en: Bauxite reserves lie beneath the tropical plateau.
examples.cn: 热带高原下埋藏着铝土矿储量。

examples.en: The refinery turns bauxite into alumina.
examples.cn: 该冶炼厂把铝土矿炼成氧化铝。

dict_mnemonic.text: 「波克塞」——红色的「盒」（box）子里装的全是铝土

root: 以法国南部村庄莱博（Les Baux）命名，1861 年法国化学界为该铝矿石造词 bauxite；后缀 -ite 为矿物学通用标志，与 hematite 等同族。

sensesIntro.en: Eight senses haul one red rock: the ore, the commodity, the refining step, the abrasives, the geology, the towns, the chemistry, and the strategic stakes.
sensesIntro.cn: 八义项运走同一块红石：矿石、商品、炼制、磨料、地质、城镇、化学与战略。

core.en: CORE IMAGE: a red village of Provence compressed into ore.
core.cn: 核心意象：普罗旺斯一座红村被压进矿石。

branches.cn: 矿物及其热带地质成因。

branches.en: Trade and strategy move the rock.
Towns and chemistry keep the name.

intro.en: The bauxite word rides the great -ite family of mineral names.
intro.cn: bauxite 一词乘 -ite 矿物命名大家族而行。

latinIntro.en: Latin -ita via Greek -ites marks minerals in scientific naming.
latinIntro.cn: 经希腊 -ites、拉丁 -ita 的后缀为科学矿物命名标志。
